_README: KNOWN-ANSWER world for the autonomy policy (tier-1 phase C, shadow).
The C2-beacon evidence, plus the admin's policy as a Key Store record. The
policy decision depends on the verdict the agent delivers and on which
lookups it cites, so both the evidence and the policy are fixed here.
No `limits` here: the offline store persists across runs, so a per-day cap would grade the harness's own history. Limits are unit-tested (test_autonomy_shadow, test_autonomy_shadow_table).
